verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents Global Accounts for receiving bank transfers into the Wallet and connected accounts for platform customers. The evidence never describes the finance lead opening multiple checking sub-accounts, and nothing shows rules that auto-allocate incoming deposits across accounts. Receiving funds and creating connected accounts are adjacent capabilities, not this story.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can open multiple checking sub-accounts and auto-allocate incoming deposits across them
